decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options for a versatile backpack. My consideration set included hydration packs (prod_backpacks_078 and prod_backpacks_126), a traditional school-style pack (prod_backpacks_155), a lightweight travel pack (prod_backpacks_156), and a sling (prod_backpacks_089). I excluded items like tents and pillows as they didn't match the primary 'backpack' search. Ultimately, I selected the Gelindo 18L Hiking Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_078) because it had the highest overall rating (4.7) and numerous positive reviews highlighting its spaciousness and utility, offering better value than the more expensive Sojourner brand.
